predictions.claim: Within one to three years, inference will be seen primarily as a capability rather than a cost or convenience lever, with tokens/sec equating to deliverable intelligence.
predictions.speaker: Tanishq Kumar

predictions.claim: The amount of human-generated internet text will grow ~3% per year while pretraining compute grows 4-5x per year, so compute spent per data point will rise ~4x year over year, making data the binding constraint.
predictions.speaker: Konwoo Kim

predictions.claim: The joint regularization-plus-ensembling data-efficiency win (~5x) will stay roughly constant even at seed token scales of 10 trillion tokens if the data scaling laws extrapolate.
predictions.speaker: Konwoo Kim

predictions.claim: Finding the right inductive biases via classical theory could close the large sample-efficiency gap between AI and humans, yielding major capability gains.
predictions.speaker: Akshay Vegesna
